name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.
